description: This file implements an adapter class for integrating AWS Bedrock large language models (LLMs) into the Pipecat framework. It provides methods for converting message formats, handling context, and preparing function schemas specific to AWS Bedrock API interactions.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMInvocationParams
classes.description: TypedDict defining invocation parameters specific to AWS Bedrock's LLM API.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for integrating AWS Bedrock LLMs with Pipecat, handling message conversion, context extraction, and tool schema formatting.

classes.name: ConvertedMessages
classes.description: Dataclass used internally to hold converted messages in Bedrock format along with optional system message.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Returns the identifier string used for LLMSpecificMessages, here 'aws'.

methods.name: AWSBedrockLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Converts a generic LLMContext into AWS Bedrock specific invocation parameters, including message formatting and tool passing.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context)
methods.description: Prepares messages for safe logging by sanitizing sensitive content, such as images.

methods.name: ConvertedMessages _from_universal_context_messages( self, universal_context_messages: List[LLMContextMessage] )
methods.description: Converts a list of LLMContextMessages into Bedrock-compatible message format, handling system message extraction and message merging.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _from_universal_context_message(self, message: LLMContextMessage)
methods.description: Converts a single LLMContextMessage into a dictionary format suitable for Bedrock, handling specific message types.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _from_standard_message(self, message: LLMStandardMessage)
methods.description: Transforms a standard message format into AWS Bedrock message format, dealing with tool calls, text content, and images.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_bedrock_function_format(function: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Converts a FunctionSchema into Bedrock's tool specification format.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Converts a ToolsSchema into a list of Bedrock-compatible function call definitions.

ctags.name: to_provider_tools_format
ctags.pattern: /^    def to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
